pr.title: Refactor physics step into integrate(); tune jump feel

reason: The pinned behaviour step-applies-air-control-reduced-acceleration held on base, fails on head, and the pull request does not announce it.

intent.summary: The pull request refactors the physics step function into a separate integrate() function and adjusts jump-related constants to improve readability and feel.
intended_changes: Increased coyote frames from 4 to 6 to reduce missed jumps near platform edges.
Raised terminal fall speed from 18 to 22 to make long falls feel snappier and landings more responsive.

data.name: step-applies-air-control-reduced-acceleration
data.reason: The refactor accidentally removed the `state.grounded` check from the friction function, causing ground friction (RUN_FRICTION=0.985) to be applied in the air where BASE used 1.0, reducing effective air acceleration. The PR claims 'same math' and only announces coyote/terminal speed changes.
